Brands.Name: Levi's
Brands.Why: Denim with the same fits for decades, so the size is known before buying.

Brands.Name: lululemon
Brands.Why: Technical fabrics that keep their shape and colour after years of washing.

Brands.Name: adidas
Brands.Why: Leather and suede Originals sneakers and technical running shoes; skip the basic polyester lines.

Brands.Name: Reebok
Brands.Why: Classic Leather and Club C: simple leather sneakers that last for years.

Brands.Name: Uniqlo
Brands.Why: Best value for merino, Supima cotton and down basics; Uniqlo U is the stronger design line.

Brands.Name: Patagonia
Brands.Why: Built to last and repaired for life (Ironclad Guarantee, Worn Wear).

Brands.Name: J.Crew
Brands.Why: Good cotton and wool basics; Ludlow suits and cashmere are the strong lines.

Brands.Name: Brooks Brothers
Brands.Why: Non-iron Supima shirts and traditional tailoring with stable sizing.

Brands.Name: Lacoste
Brands.Why: The petit piqué polo, made the same way for 90 years.

Brands.Name: Thursday Boots
Brands.Why: Goodyear-welted leather boots at a fair full price.

Brands.Name: Clarks
Brands.Why: Desert Boots and Wallabees: suede uppers on crepe soles, unchanged for decades.

Brands.Name: ECCO
Brands.Why: Owns its tanneries; long-lasting leather on comfortable soles.

Brands.Name: Timberland
Brands.Why: The 6-inch premium boot: waterproof leather that lasts for years.

Brands.Name: Massimo Dutti
Brands.Why: Natural fibres (wool, linen, leather) at high-street prices.

Brands.Name: Taylor Stitch
Brands.Why: Heavy organic fabrics, made to be repaired and resold (Restitch).

Brands.Name: Reigning Champ
Brands.Why: Heavy terry sweats cut and sewn in Canada.

Brands.Name: Todd Snyder
Brands.Why: Italian and Japanese mill fabrics; frequent real sales.

Brands.Name: Spier & Mackay
Brands.Why: Well-made shirts and tailoring at very fair full prices.

Brands.Name: Charles Tyrwhitt
Brands.Why: Two-fold cotton shirts in fixed fits and sleeve lengths.

Brands.Name: Hilditch & Key
Brands.Why: Jermyn Street shirts, hand-cut, sold since 1899.

Brands.Name: Peper Harow
Brands.Why: Goodyear-welted English shoes made in Northamptonshire.

Brands.Name: Sunspel
Brands.Why: English cotton T-shirts and the Riviera polo; long-staple cotton that lasts.

Brands.Name: Arket
Brands.Why: Natural fibres and clear material information on every item.

Brands.Name: COS
Brands.Why: Wool and cotton pieces with clean, lasting cuts.

Brands.Name: New Balance
Brands.Why: Made in USA and Made in UK lines (990, 991) are built to a premium standard.

Brands.Name: Arc'teryx
Brands.Why: Best-in-class shells with a strong warranty and repair service.

Brands.Name: The North Face
Brands.Why: Summit Series and down jackets are the quality lines; skip the fashion lines.

Brands.Name: Salomon
Brands.Why: Trail shoes built for mountains; the XT-6 also works as an everyday sneaker.

Brands.Name: Veja
Brands.Why: Leather and organic cotton sneakers with an open supply chain.

Brands.Name: GANT
Brands.Why: Oxford shirts and lambswool knits in the American preppy tradition.

Brands.Name: Red Wing Heritage
Brands.Why: Iron Ranger and Moc Toe boots: thick leather, resoleable for decades.

Brands.Name: Barbour
Brands.Why: Waxed cotton jackets that are rewaxed and repaired, not replaced.

Brands.Name: A.P.C.
Brands.Why: Raw Japanese denim that ages well; simple cuts.

Brands.Name: Everlane
Brands.Why: Factory and cost shown for each item; good cashmere and denim basics.

Brands.Name: Quince
Brands.Why: Grade-A Mongolian cashmere and silk at very low full prices.

Brands.Name: Sézane
Brands.Why: French knitwear and blouses made in small runs.

Brands.Name: Theory
Brands.Why: Good wool tailoring and stretch suiting that keeps its shape.

Brands.Name: Vince
Brands.Why: Cashmere knits and silk with a soft, lasting hand.

Brands.Name: Madewell
Brands.Why: Well-cut denim and knits; part of the J.Crew group.

Brands.Name: & Other Stories
Brands.Why: Better fabrics than most of the high street, with clear material details.

Brands.Name: Aritzia
Brands.Why: Own labels (Wilfred, Babaton) with strong coats and trousers.
